lesson.title: Practice: Dm <-> Em — 1-minute changes
lesson.one_line_promise: Build fluency on Dm <-> Em until 30+ clean changes/min.
objectives: Run a 1-minute Dm <-> Em change count
Hit 30 clean changes/min (advance) and aim for 60 (goal)
Let the app remember your weak pairs for spaced review

exercises.name: 1-minute change drill — Dm <-> Em
exercises.purpose: Count completed Dm <-> Em changes in 60s; the 30/60 engine records your rate into the fluency memory.
exercises.coaching: Metronome on. Dm to Em, back and forth, as many clean changes as you can in one minute. The app remembers this pair — your weakest pairs come back for spaced review automatically.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: Today we drill Dm <-> Em. Clean, even changes — not fast messy ones.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: A higher count than last time means your hands are learning. That is the only metric that matters here.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Logged to your fluency memory. If this pair is weak, it will resurface in review.
